title: Review a commit with guards, a parallel version and leftovers
changeMessage: Add discount support to cart totals
pattern: impossible-case guards; swallowed or masked errors; parallel versions; leftovers
expectation: Seeded: null and type guards for lines the API boundary already validates, with a silent return of 0 (price.js); a second cart total function (totalV2.js); a debug print and commented-out code (cart.js). Without guidance the review catches the debug print and misses the guards or the parallel version.
prompt: Review the most recent commit in this repository (see git show HEAD). Write your findings to review.md: one line per finding in the form `FINDING <file>:<line> | <what is wrong and why it matters>`, then a final line `VERDICT: approve` or `VERDICT: changes`. Do not edit any other file.
